title: [AUG-177] Research: in-progress spinner after transcript processing reaches 100%
why_we_need_this: Rodion's feedback (Feature Request 2): on the EXTERMINATUS INITIATED processing screen, once the progress hits 00:00:00 / 100% there is no sign that work is still going on, so it looks frozen. He wants a spinner/animation until the process fully ends, in August's visual style. Source: @docs/feedback/2026-11-rodion-feedback.md
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Stages that run after 100% listed with file:line refs (merge, semantic pass, corrections, cleanup) and how long they typically take.
- [ ] Options compared: generic spinner vs named post-processing stage text vs both; reduced-motion handling.
- [ ] HTML mockup: a self-contained file @docs/mockups/AUG-177/processing-spinner.html (opens in a browser, no build) with the EXTERMINATUS INITIATED screen in its post-100% state and 2–3 animated spinner variants in August style, plus the reduced-motion fallback; built on August's real design tokens (frontend-design route, 0 border-radius).
- [ ] The user picks a variant on the mockup (AskUserQuestion); the decision is recorded in this card.
- [ ] CLOSURE CONDITION: an implementation task with the agreed scope, SMART acceptance criteria and a link to the chosen mockup is created on the board; its ID is written into this card and into the roadmap line in @project-context/roadmap/README.md.
important_constraints:
Research only — no code changes. Closed only by creating the agreed implementation task. No diagnostics (method names, timings) in user UI. Roadmap: M2 Live session control. Order: 8/10.

## Research findings (2026-11-04)

**Why it looks frozen.** The countdown is client-side only (@client/src/components/TranscriptView.tsx:215 ChronoRing, :238-243): progress = elapsed / session.estimatedDuration. At zero (:252-258) the digits lock at 00:00:00 / 100%, the «Завершение в HH:MM» bar is removed (:313), the red EXTERMINATUS banner appears (:272-278). Only Elapsed keeps ticking. Red + 00:00:00 reads as "done / alarm", not "working". SessionStatus (@server/src/types.ts:3) has no post-processing stage; the client polls every 5 s (@client/src/App.tsx:20).

**Why the ETA misses.** estimatedDuration = audio s × median ratio of the last 10 runs (@server/src/services/performanceTracker.ts getEstimatedRatio). The ratio is start → completed, so it includes the semantic pass, which is capped by fixed budgets and depends on settings, not on audio length. Ratios recorded on this machine: 0.019–0.38.

**Stages after whisper exits** (@server/src/routes/sessions.ts runTranscription :106 / runDualTranscription :163):
- whisper :119 (single) / :184-185 (dual, mic then system) — 0.02–0.05 × audio s on CUDA
- mute drop + merge :122-124 / :188-193 → transcriptMerger.ts — < 1 s
- semantic pass :130-132 / :200-202 → @server/src/services/semanticCheck.ts:308 runSemanticPass, :327 scorePerplexity — 0.8 s (13 s clip), 60 s (255 s call), 240 s budget hit (3454 s call, 388 scored / 665 skipped); cap PERPLEXITY.timeBudgetMs 240 000 (:18)
- meaning corrections :330-336 / Groq :300-304 — seconds to minutes; cap CORRECTIONS.timeBudgetMs 180 000, 40 items (:22-28), Groq waitForBudgetMs 60 000
- render + write transcript/corrections :136-141 / :206-211 — < 1 s
- status → completed :143-148 / :213-218 — visible on the next poll (≤ 5 s)
- perf ratio, boosted WAV unlink, auto-delete WAV :150-158 / :228-237 — < 1 s

**Measured frozen window** (server/data/sessions): 255 s call → ring at zero at 34 s, done at 69 s (perplexity 60 s); 370 s call → zero at 33 s, done at ~62 s. Typical 30 s – 4 min, worst case ≈ 8 min (240 + 180 + 60 s budgets).

**Options.** 1 generic spinner only (client, no API) — alive but says nothing for up to 7 min. 2 named stage text only (server field session.processingStage, 5 s poll) — honest, no motion. 3 both (recommended) — indicator + user-worded stage label + Elapsed; reduced motion drops the indicator and keeps the label. Stage labels must be user words (Cleaning up / Checking the text / Suggesting fixes / Saving), never method names, timings or model names.

**Mockup:** @docs/mockups/AUG-177/processing-spinner.html — variants A Gauss orbit, B Tick sweep, C Data bar; theme, stage, reduced-motion toggles.

## Decision (2026-11-04, Vlad)
- D1 Variant: **B — Tick sweep** (A and C rejected).
- D2 Stage text: **indicator + server stage label** (option 3).
- D3 Ring center at zero: **keep 00:00:00 / 100%**, the stage text lives under the ring (the "stage word replaces digits" proposal rejected).
- D4 Banner: **keep the red EXTERMINATUS INITIATED** during post-processing.
- D5 Honest ETA (whisper-only perf ratio): not in scope; separate follow-up if wanted.

**Implementation task: AUG-189-m1fo5w** (roadmap M2 line updated).
